exposure: conversion of lumbar epidural anesthesia to general anesthesia
cohort: The participants were parturient mothers undergoing lower segment caesarean section (LSCS) surgery with lumbar epidural anesthesia.
finding: The study found that a higher Perfusion Index (PI) was associated with non-conversion of lumbar epidural anesthesia to general anesthesia, suggesting its role as an indicator for the efficacy of lumbar epidural anesthesia in caesarean section surgery.
mod_finding: The study investigated the Perfusion Index as an indicator of the efficacy of lumbar epidural anesthesia during lower segment caesarean section (LSCS) surgery.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken during lower segment caesarean section (LSCS) surgery.
